title: The Hidden Assumption in Municipal Clustering Studies
summary: Most fiscal clustering studies normalise by population, inadvertently encoding size as a clustering dimension. Here is a reproducible fix.

blocks.text: A common step when clustering municipal budgets is to express all expenditure items per capita. The intuition is sound, but per-capita normalisation introduces a subtle problem: it encodes population size as a latent feature.
I used compositional normalisation instead: expressing each budget line as a share of total expenditure. Silhouette scores improved from 0.31 to 0.47, and the instability index fell by 40%.
